MathJax 3.2.2 (https://www.mathjax.org), Apache License 2.0 (see LICENSE).

`tex-svg.js` is the file `es5/tex-svg.js` of the npm package `mathjax@3.2.2`: TeX input,
SVG output, fonts included, so that no other file is needed. It is loaded by `js/post.js`.
To update it, replace it by the same file of a newer version and check a blog post.
